#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

string input, output;
bool atReplaced = false;

bool isDotSequence(const string& s, size_t pos) {
    return (pos + 2 < s.length() && 
            s[pos] == 'd' && s[pos+1] == 'o' && s[pos+2] == 't');
}

bool isAtSequence(const string& s, size_t pos) {
    return (pos + 1 < s.length() && 
            s[pos] == 'a' && s[pos+1] == 't');
}

int main() {
    cin >> input;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < input.length(); ) {
        if (i > 0 && i + 2 < input.length() - 1 && 
            input[i] == 'd' && isDotSequence(input, i)) {
            output += '.';
            i += 3;
            continue;
        }
        
        if (!atReplaced && i > 0 && i + 1 < input.length() - 1 && 
            input[i] == 'a' && isAtSequence(input, i)) {
            output += '@';
            i += 2;
            atReplaced = true;
            continue;
        }
        
        output += input[i];
        i++;
    }
    
    cout << output;
    return 0;
}
